persona: Liam operates as a commercial delivery driver navigating the Southwark and central London areas. He manages daily dynamic route planning around Transport for London road closures, calculates Ultra Low Emission Zone compliance costs for his vehicle fleet, and coordinates with loading bays at Borough Market. His routine requires precise scheduling to avoid peak congestion and bridge lifts.
task: Use the local traffic bulletin to replace the closed street in your daily route notes with the recommended detour street.
